decision.explanation: Both positions are directly supported by the original sources. Document d1 (sources D1S1–D1S15) confirms Jay Morris's current role as a member of the Louisiana House of Representatives. Document d2 (sources D2S1–D2S17) states that Jay Morris has taken the oath as a Senator of Ireland. These are two distinct roles held by the same individual and are not contradictory. The instruction emphasizes preserving distinct valid referents and complementary answers when supported by the original context.
